facts.fact: The ADD, with the DGSN, runs an identification and authentication platform based on the electronic national ID card (CNIE), launched in 2022, with the ADD acting as national trusted third party.
The ADD says the CNIE authentication platform has integrated more than 90 service providers from the public and private sectors since 2022.
Citizens download the app Mon identité numérique to use the CNIE as an NFC card to reach online services, the ADD says.
